newsitem.title: USA: Caliber Systems completes Viking sale.
newsitem.headline: Caliber Systems completes Viking sale.

text.p: Caliber System Inc said Tuesday it completed the sale of the operations of Viking Freight's southwestern division to senior central management and the Moyes Group of Swift Transportation.
The total value of the sale, including the anticipated proceeds from the properties retained by Caliber, is about $80 million.
The new regional carrier will operate under the name Central Freight Lines Inc.
The company said the southwestern division is the territory served by the former central freight lines.
Central Freight Lines will operate 57 terminals in eight states.
